sections.label: SPECIALTY CONDITION
sections.html: Psionics · Self · Stackable. Strain is cumulative and remains until removed. When you use a Psionics Action or Reaction, you may gain 1 Strain to gain 1 additional Surge.

sections.label: 3–4 STRAIN
sections.html: Each Psionics Action or Reaction burns 1 additional die.

sections.label: 5+ STRAIN
sections.html: After resolving a Psionics Action or Reaction, suffer 1 Psychic damage.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Strain is removed only by effects that specifically remove Strain or by the appropriate Recovery.
